payload.summary: Producer cadence (4h) is DOUBLE the signal TTL (2h), so alert-commander-market is structurally blind to news-scout for roughly a third of its fires. Measured end-to-end this tick, not inferred, and it retro-explains an empty-bus cycle observed 15 minutes earlier.
payload.measurement:
MEASURED INPUTS
  TTL          = 2h exactly. Signal 11340 created ~08:08:08Z, expiry field reads 2026-08-25 10:08:08. Same for 11341.
  Producer     = news-scout. Slots: news-scout-offhours cron "0 */4 * * *"; news-scout-sentiment cron "30 1 * * 1-5".
  Consumer     = alert-commander. Slot alert-commander-market cron "*/15 2-8 * * 1-5" -> 28 fires per weekday.
  Consumer query window = 2h (c253 notebook: "get_agent_signals(agent, 2h)" plus 6 explicit signal_type queries).

DERIVED COVERAGE inside the consumer's 02:00-08:59 window
  news-scout fires at 01:30, 04:00, 08:00 -> signals alive 01:30-03:30, 04:00-06:00, 08:00-10:00.
  DEAD ZONES inside 02:00-08:59: 03:30-04:00 (30 min) and 06:00-08:00 (120 min) = 150 min of a 419-min window.
  ~36% of alert-commander-market's daily fires -- about 10 of 28 -- can see no news-scout signal at all, by construction.

INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION (not the same observation restated)
  c253 ran 07:52Z and reported the bus empty of ALL SIX consumed types. 07:52 falls inside the computed 06:00-08:00 dead zone. The arithmetic predicted that cycle before I looked at it.

SAME-TICK RACE, on top of the dead zone
  At the 08:00 tick the dispatcher fans out producer and consumer in ONE batch. Both alert-commander spawns went out at 08:06; news-scout posted its signals at 08:08. The consumer reads a bus the producer has not written yet, so even the "alive" window effectively opens ~2 minutes after the consumer has already queried.

SCOPE LIMIT -- do not overstate
  Other producers of urgent_news / chain_catalyst were NOT enumerated. This quantifies news-scout-sourced coverage only. If other agents emit these types on a tighter cadence the practical gap is smaller, and that should be measured before any fix is sized.
payload.separate_discrepancy:
SEPARATE DISCREPANCY, filed as an observation rather than a verdict.

news-scout's return claims 4 signals posted: 11338 (urgent_news, VIC), 11339 (urgent_news, VPB), 11340 (chain_catalyst), 11341 (chain_catalyst).

Only 11340 and 11341 are retrievable. Queries run:
  get_agent_signals{from_agent:"news-scout", hours_back:6}                        -> 2 rows (11340, 11341)
  get_agent_signals{from_agent:"news-scout", signal_type:"urgent_news", hours_back:2} -> "Khong co tin hieu moi"
  get_agent_signals{agent:"alert-commander", signal_type:"urgent_news", hours_back:6} -> "Khong co tin hieu moi"

Both windows comfortably cover the claimed creation time. I do NOT conclude the posts failed -- urgent_news may carry different addressing or visibility than chain_catalyst, and I did not read the emitter. What is established is only this: two of four returned IDs are not retrievable by either the producer-side or the consumer-side query for their declared type. Worth one look at the urgent_news write path.

Note also both visible rows already read "Trang thai: read" within ~6 minutes of creation, with no consumer cycle in between that I can account for.
payload.why_it_surfaced_now: The 08:00Z tick fanned out producer and consumer in the same batch for the first time this session, which put both cadences and the TTL in view at once.
payload.same_tick_observation:
SAME-TICK OBSERVATION, reported with its ambiguity intact.

The co-fired consumer (alert-commander-market, cycle c254) reported its bus "empty of all 6 consumed types ... no chain_catalyst signal in window", while news-scout created chain_catalyst 11340 and 11341 at 08:08:08Z in that same tick. c254's notebook stamp is 08:08:49Z, so its Step 3 query ran within the same MINUTE as the producer's write.

That is too close to attribute confidently to the fan-out race rather than to ordinary query timing. It is consistent with the race and does not establish it. The DEAD-ZONE half of this finding does not depend on it and stands on the cadence-vs-TTL arithmetic alone.
